story_description: Implement the network layer responsible for fetching registry data from remote sources with proper error handling, signature verification, retry logic, and fallback URL support for reliability.
task_description: Create the network fetcher class that retrieves registry JSON from primary and fallback URLs, verifies Ed25519 signatures, handles network errors gracefully, and provides async/await API for downstream consumers.
atom_description: Implement RegistryFetcher as an actor in Blaze/Sources/Registry/RegistryFetcher.swift providing async methods to fetch registry data from Cogit0 API (primary) or GitHub Raw (fallback). Includes Ed25519 signature verification using CryptoKit, exponential backoff retry logic, request timeout handling, ETag-based conditional fetching for bandwidth efficiency, and structured error types for callers to handle gracefully.
problem_statement: The Blaze app needs to fetch extension registry data from remote servers securely. Without signature verification, a man-in-the-middle attack could inject malicious skills/plugins/agents. Without retry logic and fallback URLs, temporary network issues would prevent users from accessing the registry. The fetcher must balance security, reliability, and performance.
scope_in: RegistryFetcher actor with async fetch methods for thread-safe network access
Primary URL configuration pointing to Cogit0 API endpoint
Fallback URL configuration pointing to GitHub Raw content
Ed25519 signature verification using CryptoKit framework
Public key storage and rotation support for signature verification
Exponential backoff retry logic with configurable max attempts and base delay
Request timeout configuration with sensible defaults (30 seconds)
ETag header support for conditional GET requests to reduce bandwidth
RegistryFetchError enum with specific error cases for caller handling
URLSession configuration with appropriate caching policy and timeout
Cancellation support via Swift structured concurrency
Logging of fetch attempts, retries, and failures for debugging
scope_out: SQLite caching of fetched data (handled by R003-CACHE)
JSON parsing into model types (handled by caller using R001-MODELS)
UI for displaying fetch progress (handled by R005-COORDINATOR and UI atoms)

assumptions: Cogit0 API returns registry JSON with detached Ed25519 signature in X-Registry-Signature header
GitHub Raw fallback serves the same JSON but without signature (trusted due to HTTPS)
Public key for signature verification is bundled in app resources as registry-public-key.pem
Network requests use standard URLSession with default HTTPS certificate validation
Registry JSON response is typically under 1MB making single-request fetch appropriate
Server supports ETag headers for conditional GET optimization
constraints: Must use only Apple frameworks (Foundation, CryptoKit) - no third-party networking libraries
Must be an actor for thread-safe concurrent access from multiple callers
Must support Swift structured concurrency cancellation
Must not block main thread during fetch operations
Must handle airplane mode and no-connectivity scenarios gracefully
Must complete fetch attempt within 60 seconds total including all retries
Public key must be stored securely and not hardcoded as string literal
functional_requirements: FR-01: RegistryFetcher must expose async fetch() method returning Result<Data, RegistryFetchError>
FR-02: Fetch must first attempt primary URL (Cogit0 API) before falling back to GitHub Raw
FR-03: Primary URL response must include X-Registry-Signature header for Ed25519 verification
FR-04: Signature verification must use CryptoKit Curve25519.Signing to validate response body
FR-05: Failed signature verification must return RegistryFetchError.signatureInvalid
FR-06: Network errors must trigger exponential backoff retry up to 3 attempts
FR-07: Retry delays must be 1s, 2s, 4s (exponential with base 1 second)
FR-08: After primary URL exhausts retries, fetcher must attempt fallback URL
FR-09: Fallback URL fetch does not require signature verification (HTTPS trusted)
FR-10: Request must include If-None-Match header when cached ETag is available
FR-11: Server 304 Not Modified response must return RegistryFetchError.notModified for cache hit
FR-12: Request timeout must be configurable with default of 30 seconds per attempt
FR-13: Total operation timeout must be 60 seconds including all retries and fallback
FR-14: Cancellation via Task.cancel must abort in-flight requests promptly
FR-15: All fetch outcomes must be logged with os.log for debugging
nonfunctional_requirements: NFR-01: Successful fetch from primary URL must complete in under 5 seconds on broadband
NFR-02: Memory usage during fetch must not exceed 10MB for typical 1MB response
NFR-03: Actor isolation must prevent data races in concurrent fetch calls
NFR-04: Public key loading must complete in under 10ms at app launch
NFR-05: Signature verification must complete in under 50ms for 1MB payload
NFR-06: All public APIs must have documentation comments with parameter descriptions
implementation_steps: Create Blaze/Sources/Registry/RegistryFetcher.swift file with file header comment
Define RegistryFetchError enum with cases: networkError(URLError), signatureInvalid, signatureMissing, notModified, timeout, cancelled, invalidResponse, publicKeyLoadFailed
Define RegistryFetcherConfiguration struct with primaryURL (URL), fallbackURL (URL), requestTimeout (TimeInterval), maxRetries (Int), baseRetryDelay (TimeInterval), publicKeyResourceName (String)
Define RegistryFetcher actor with private urlSession (URLSession), configuration (RegistryFetcherConfiguration), cachedETag (String?), publicKey (Curve25519.Signing.PublicKey?)
Implement private loadPublicKey() method to read PEM file from Bundle.main and parse into Curve25519.Signing.PublicKey
Implement private verifySignature(data: Data, signature: Data) -> Bool using CryptoKit Curve25519.Signing.PublicKey.isValidSignature
Implement private fetchWithRetry(url: URL, requireSignature: Bool) async throws -> Data with exponential backoff loop
Implement private performRequest(url: URL) async throws -> (Data, HTTPURLResponse) wrapping URLSession.data(for:)
Implement private extractSignature(from response: HTTPURLResponse) -> Data? parsing X-Registry-Signature header as base64
Implement public fetch() async -> Result<Data, RegistryFetchError> orchestrating primary then fallback attempts
Implement public fetch(ignoreCache: Bool) async -> Result<Data, RegistryFetchError> to bypass ETag optimization
Add URLSession configuration with timeoutIntervalForRequest and ephemeral configuration for privacy
Add os.log statements for fetch start, retry attempts, signature verification, and completion
Add Task.checkCancellation() calls at appropriate points for cancellation support
Write unit tests in Tests/RegistryFetcherTests.swift using URLProtocol mock
Write integration test that fetches from real Cogit0 API endpoint (disabled by default)

edge_cases: Primary URL returns 200 but missing X-Registry-Signature header - must return signatureMissing error
Primary URL returns 200 with invalid base64 in signature header - must return signatureInvalid error
Primary URL returns 200 with valid base64 but wrong signature - must return signatureInvalid error
Both primary and fallback URLs fail - must return last error from fallback attempt
Network available but DNS resolution fails - must map to networkError case
Request times out mid-transfer - must cancel and retry if attempts remain
Device enters airplane mode during fetch - must return networkError promptly
Concurrent fetch calls from multiple Tasks - actor must serialize safely
Very large response (over 10MB) - must handle without memory exhaustion
Server returns 5xx error - must retry with exponential backoff
Server returns 4xx error - must not retry (client error)
Empty response body with 200 status - must return invalidResponse error
Public key PEM file missing from bundle - must return publicKeyLoadFailed at init
Public key PEM file corrupted - must return publicKeyLoadFailed at init
ETag returned on first fetch, 304 on second - must handle cache hit correctly
failure_modes: Network unreachable - return RegistryFetchError.networkError with underlying URLError
DNS resolution failed - return RegistryFetchError.networkError with URLError.cannotFindHost
Connection refused - return RegistryFetchError.networkError with URLError.cannotConnectToHost
Request timeout - return RegistryFetchError.timeout after all retries exhausted
SSL certificate invalid - return RegistryFetchError.networkError with URLError.serverCertificateUntrusted
Public key load failed - return RegistryFetchError.publicKeyLoadFailed

notes: This atom is security-critical since it establishes the trust boundary for remote extension code. Signature verification prevents supply chain attacks where an attacker modifies registry content in transit. The fallback URL without signature is a reliability tradeoff - if primary is down, users can still access registry via GitHub's HTTPS, accepting GitHub as a trusted party.

risks: Public key rotation requires app update - users on old versions cannot verify new signatures
Fallback URL without signature verification weakens security if attacker can intercept GitHub traffic
Exponential backoff may delay fetch unacceptably when network is flaky but functional
CryptoKit API changes in future macOS versions could break signature verification
Large response handling may cause memory pressure on low-memory Macs
mitigations: Implement multiple public key support with key IDs for rotation without breaking old clients
Log and monitor fallback URL usage to detect potential attacks or primary URL issues
Add configurable retry policy with option to fail fast for time-sensitive use cases
Pin CryptoKit API usage to stable interfaces and test on macOS beta releases
Stream large responses to disk if size exceeds threshold rather than buffering in memory
risk_register.blast_radius: Medium - fetcher failure prevents registry access but does not affect core session functionality. Users can continue using already-installed extensions. Only new extension discovery and installation would be blocked.
risk_register.fallback_plan: If fetcher has critical bugs, disable signature verification temporarily by accepting all responses. This reduces security but maintains functionality. Long-term fix is to patch fetcher and ship update.
